gap_analysis: Seeded from the reviewed ledger (MXFP4 ckpt measurements + standalone MXFP8): MXFP8 KDA in_proj (N=49376) 1.16-1.40x standalone on cuBLASLt _scaled_mm, plus a standalone BF16->MXFP8 activation quant per MXFP8 consumer (+40 us/call, 161 calls/step under NVFP4 since the KDA in_proj and shared gate_up inputs come from AttnRes in BF16); router path (BF16 router GEMM N=896 FP32-out ~2x, separate router top-k, latent RMSNorm) ~20 ms; small-N BF16 GEMMs (qkv_a N=2272, q_proj, f_b_proj K=128) 1.2-3.5x; AttnRes pre/post ~1.3x. Big BF16 GEMMs (g_proj, o_proj, dense) are already at 0.96-1.09x the model (measured). First action: per-shape microbench of every backend at M=16384/8192 to replace the ledger with measured numbers.
inefficiencies: HYPOTHESIS: cuBLASLt MXFP8 tactic for N=49376 (not a multiple of 256) is not the best 2-CTA 2x-K tile; standalone 1.16-1.40x
